COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1557 of 2026
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. G.D. Joshi, learned Counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. DCS Rawat, learned Counsel for the 
respondents. 
3. Petitioner has challenged the order dated 
08.04.2026 whereby petitioner, who is working as 
Junior Station In-charge in the office of Transport 
Corporation, has been transferred from Kashipur to 
Ramnagar. 
4. It is contended by petitioner that petitioner is 
scheduled to be retired in May, 2027 and barely one 
year is left for his service, still he has been 
transferred. The family of petitioner resides in 
Kashipur and further, he is suffering from various age 
related ailments. 
5. Learned Counsel for the respondents prays for 
and is granted six weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
6. List on 25.08.2026.
7. Meanwhile, the effect and operation of impugned 
order dated 08.04.2026 shall remain stayed. 
8. Stay Application (IA/1/2026) stands disposed of.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 15.06.2026 R.Dang
